rubric: Binary file relevance: directly implements the requested responsibility in executable source. An import, configuration reference or route forwarding alone is not relevant unless the query asks for that responsibility. All 11 files were read before observing benchmark output. Other files are unjudged. This is a purposive small source-reviewed sample, not an independent human gold or whole-project recall.
edge_semantics: imports_from: all literal CommonJS require strings, including immediately invoked require; exclude dynamic require expressions, normalize relative paths with JS extension/index resolution; unresolved relative paths retain rel: prefix. functions: named declarations, exports and Schema.methods function properties, excluding anonymous callbacks, variables and comments. Compare file/function inventory, not ownership/call correctness. Deduplicate exact (file,target) pairs.
